messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Service and Subscription Management" as it appears in the following examples.
['As the Primary Contact, you must renew the service(s) listed below: SERVICE: Chase Online and Bill Pay services.', 'As the Primary Contact, you must renew the service(s) listed below: SERVICE: Barclays PhoneBanking and Online banking services.', 'If this sign up was made by the mistake, and you want to cancel the subscription, click the link under the subscription options in this message, and then change the password on your account, perhaps it was stolen.', 'This is your official notification from Chase Bank that the service(s) listed below will be deactivated and deleted if not renewed immediately.', 'This email confirms your purchase of the following subscription.', 'This account was cancelled.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

message.content: {"summary":"Renew required banking services to avoid deactivation, review subscription purchases, and cancel unwanted or mistaken subscriptions by updating account settings."}
